summary_scope: Essential data points required to provide personalized dietary recommendations for cancer patients based on ESPEN guidelines[cite: 1, 86].

items.label: Cancer Type and Stage
items.rationale: Determines metabolic impact and specific nutritional needs[cite: 9].

items.label: Treatment Type
items.rationale: Influences the type of nutritional support required[cite: 10].

items.label: Weight History
items.rationale: Tracks percentage of weight loss over 1–6 months[cite: 13].

items.label: Food Intake
items.rationale: Assesses current habits, preferences, and intolerances[cite: 14].

items.label: Nutrition Impact Symptoms
items.rationale: Symptoms that directly interfere with food consumption[cite: 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23].

items.label: Resting Energy Expenditure (REE)
items.rationale: Measured or estimated to determine caloric needs[cite: 37].

items.label: Electrolytes
items.rationale: Critical for identifying refeeding syndrome risk[cite: 39].

items.label: Screening Tools
items.rationale: Standardized methods to assess malnutrition risk[cite: 66, 67, 68, 69, 70].

items.label: Physical Activity Level (PAL)
items.rationale: Used to estimate Total Energy Expenditure (TEE)[cite: 73].

items.label: Goals of Care
items.rationale: Aligns nutrition with overall medical objectives[cite: 42].

items.label: Patient Preferences
items.rationale: Incorporates individual expectations and willingness to adhere to plans[cite: 43].
